summary: Grayscale Solana Staking ETF filed an 8-K announcing a planned Third Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust to begin regular distributions of staking rewards and conform to IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-31. The Sponsor will reduce Staking Consideration to cash no less often than quarterly and distribute proceeds net of expenses. No price per share, premium, or closing date are stated. This is a routine operational/structural amendment, not a special situation transaction. The event is a standard trust agreement update with a 20-day notice period; no activist, M&A, or capital return catalyst is present.
